title: Bug: PR#20768 introduced wrong param to test_stress_arp.py unintentionally
author: congh-nvidia
body: ### Is it platform specific generic ### Importance or Severity Critical ### Description of the bug In PR: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/20768, fixture **packets_for_test** was added to the param list of fixture **proxy_arp_enabled**. And **packets_for_test** is parameterized with **params=['v4', 'v6']**. But these 2 fixtures are not always used by a test, for the test tests/arp/test_stress_arp.py, it uses only proxy_arp_enabled. And there are problems. 1. When it's running on v6 only topo, there are failed cases which actually should not be generated: 2. When the test is running on regular topo, the test cases are actually duplicates as the fixture packets_for_test is not used in the test. ### Steps to Reproduce Run the test tests/arp/test_stress_arp.py. ### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior **proxy_arp_enabled** should not depend on **packets_for_test** as there are tests use only **proxy_arp_enabled** ### Relevant log output ```shell ``` ### Output of `show version` ```shell ``` ### Attach files (if any) _No response_
